reader_contract.figure_question: When an incomplete later input or cue arrives, does retained STSP support selective access to history components, and how is that functional expression constrained by cue content, sequence load, delay and pathway overlap?
reader_contract.terminal_inference: Pair and sequence states support multi-component access; history-supported content is the main cue boundary and the exact experienced exemplar adds a smaller advantage within the same class; functional expression depends jointly on sequence length and retention delay; high-STSP-overlap pathways make a targeted causal contribution to later recruitment and control early firing expression.
forbidden_inferences: perfect recall, capacity decoding, or unlimited load
monotonic maintenance of access at all delays
STSP alone predicts the final class
removal establishes sole encoding or a per-synapse route
the mechanism is unique or necessary in biological systems
the two panel-c gains are equal-strength all-or-none cue specificity
